escena: SCENE (a review against a wall-sized display, studio in Bogota, night): THERE IS NO OTHER LIGHT IN THE ROOM — every lamp is off and the windows are black. The only source is a wall-sized screen glowing deep azure blue, visible at the left of the frame. Verify it by these landmarks, not by mood: HER SKIN IS BLUE, not warm — the blue falls on her forehead, cheek and the back of her hand nearest the screen; the far side of her face has NO light at all and reads almost black; the white of her sweater reads BLUE, not white; her shadow on the floor is long, hard and single. Because the source is in frame this is real motivated light, not a colour grade over the image and not a filter. She stands close to the screen with one hand raised at the instant she finds what she was looking for. She wears a fine light heather-grey knit sweater. She looks at the screen, never at the camera. 50mm at f/1.8. Everything is completely unbranded, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the near edge of a matte black console in deep shadow, well outside the light from the screen
lecho.tono: DARK near black in shadow, matte, no highlights
